title: Project Radar instance config
description: One file per radar instance (one per Claude account or context). Keep it in a private repo, never in this one.

instance.description: Short id for this radar, e.g. acme, personal.

brand.description: Name shown next to 'Project Radar' in the header. Empty for none.

mark.description: One letter for the logo badge. Defaults to the first letter of brand.

linear_team.description: Linear team name or key the radar reads and writes.

linear_workspace.description: Linear workspace slug, used to build issue links (linear.app/<slug>/issue/KEY).

only_listed_projects.description: When true, the radar only syncs issues from the Linear projects listed in projects. Use it when several radars share one Linear team.

artifact_url.description: URL of this instance's radar artifact, once installed. Lets radar-setup and radar-update find it.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for due dates and the daily brief.

brief_time.description: Local time of the daily brief.

brief_language.description: Language of the brief and WhatsApp message, e.g. en, es.

brief_trigger.description: Scheduled task id of the brief. Written by radar-setup; leave empty in new configs.

people.description: People who own issues. match is a case-insensitive regex tested against the Linear assignee name.

is_me.description: The radar owner. New issues are assigned to this person by default.

calendars.description: Google Calendar ids for Key events. 'primary' is the connected account.

stopwords.description: Words ignored when matching calendar events to projects (your name, company name).

projects.description: Seed for the projects collection. Every project must exist in Linear.

brew.description: Optional inbox tab backed by a Daily Brew style Supabase schema (briefing_items, whatsapp_messages, contacts).

supabase_project.description: Supabase project ref. Read through the Supabase connector, never with keys in the page.

session.description: Post the brief as the scheduled task's final message.

whatsapp_chat.description: Chat name or JID for the WhatsApp brief. Empty to skip.

ask_template.description: Text for the Ask button. Placeholders: {ref} {title} {url}.

code_template.description: Prompt for the Code button. Placeholders: {ref} {title} {url}.
